sentences.zh: 志第九 歷三
▲大統曆法一下法原

translations.literal: ▲ Grand Concordance Calendar Method One Lower: Origins of the Method.
translations.idiomatic: ▲ Grand Concordance Calendar Method, Part One (Lower): Origins of the Method.

sentences.zh: 日月五星平定三差

translations.literal: Sun, moon, and five planets: mean, upright, and fixed three differences.
translations.idiomatic: The mean, upright, and fixed three differences for the sun, moon, and five planets.

sentences.zh: 太陽盈縮平立定三差之原。

translations.literal: Origins of the sun's expansion–contraction mean, upright, and fixed three differences.
translations.idiomatic: Origins of the solar equation's mean, upright, and fixed three differences.

sentences.zh: 冬至前後盈初縮末限，八十八日九十一刻，就整。

translations.literal: About the winter solstice, the expansion-initial and contraction-final limit: 88 days 91 ke; round to whole numbers.
translations.idiomatic: About the winter solstice, the expansion-initial and contraction-final interval is 88 days 91 quarter-hours; round to integers.

sentences.zh: 離爲六段，每段各得一十四日八十二刻。

translations.literal: Divide into six segments; each segment alike obtains 14 days 82 ke.
translations.idiomatic: Divide it into six segments of 14 days 82 quarter-hours each.

sentences.zh: 就整。
各段實測日躔度數，與平行相較，以爲積差。

translations.literal: Each segment's actually measured daily solar advance in degrees, compared with mean motion, is taken as accumulated difference.
translations.idiomatic: For each segment, compare the observed daily solar advance with the mean motion to obtain the accumulated difference.

translations.idiomatic: Subtract each segment's daily mean difference from the next segment's to obtain the first difference.

translations.idiomatic: Subtract each segment's first difference from the next segment's to obtain the second difference.

translations.literal: Set the first segment's daily mean difference, 476 fen 25 miao, as the general mean accumulation.
translations.idiomatic: Take the first segment's daily mean difference of 476′25″ as the general mean accumulation.

sentences.zh: 以第二段二差一分三十八秒，去減第一段一差十八分四十五秒，餘三十七分零七秒，不凡平積差。

translations.literal: Using the second segment's second difference of 1 fen 38 miao, subtract the first segment's first difference of 18 fen 45 miao; remainder 37 fen 07 miao—the text reads 不凡平積差.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the first segment's first difference of 18′45″ from the second segment's second difference of 1′38″, leaving 37′07″ as the general mean accumulation difference.

sentences.zh: 另置第一段二差一分三十八秒，折半得六十九秒，爲凡立積差。

translations.literal: Separately set the first segment's second difference of 1 fen 38 miao; halve it to obtain 69 miao as the general upright accumulation difference.
translations.idiomatic: Halve the first segment's second difference of 1′38″ to obtain 69″ as the general upright accumulation difference.

sentences.zh: 以凡平積差三十七分零七秒，加入凡平積四百七十六分二十五秒，共得五百一十三分三十二秒，爲定差。

translations.literal: Add the general mean accumulation difference of 37 fen 07 miao to the general mean accumulation of 476 fen 25 miao; together 513 fen 32 miao, as the fixed difference.
translations.idiomatic: Add the general mean accumulation difference of 37′07″ to the general mean accumulation of 476′25″, giving 513′32″ as the fixed difference.

sentences.zh: 以凡立積差六十九秒，去減凡平積差三十七分零七秒，餘三十六分三十八秒爲實，以段日一十四日八十二刻爲法除之，得二分四十六秒爲平差。

translations.literal: Subtract the general upright accumulation difference of 69 miao from the general mean accumulation difference of 37 fen 07 miao; remainder 36 fen 38 miao as dividend; divide by the segment days of 14 days 82 ke as divisor; obtain 2 fen 46 miao as the mean difference.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the general upright accumulation difference of 69″ from the general mean accumulation difference of 37′07″; the remainder of 36′38″ is the dividend. Dividing by the segment length of 14 days 82 quarter-hours yields 2′46″ as the mean difference.

sentences.zh: 置凡立積差六十九秒爲實，以段日爲法除二次，得三十一微，爲立差。

translations.literal: Set the general upright accumulation difference of 69 miao as dividend; divide by segment days twice as divisor; obtain 31 wei as the upright difference.
translations.idiomatic: Take the general upright accumulation difference of 69″ as dividend and divide twice by the segment days to obtain 31 wei as the upright difference.

sentences.zh: 夏至前後縮初盈末限，九十三日七十一刻，就整。

translations.literal: About the summer solstice, the contraction-initial and expansion-final limit: 93 days 71 ke; round to whole numbers.
translations.idiomatic: About the summer solstice, the contraction-initial and expansion-final interval is 93 days 71 quarter-hours; round to integers.

sentences.zh: 離爲六段，每段各得一十五日六十二刻。

translations.literal: Divide into six segments; each segment alike obtains 15 days 62 ke.
translations.idiomatic: Divide it into six segments of 15 days 62 quarter-hours each.

sentences.zh: 就整。
各段實測日躔度數，與平行相較，以爲積差。

translations.literal: Each segment's actually measured daily solar advance in degrees, compared with mean motion, is taken as accumulated difference.
translations.idiomatic: For each segment, compare the observed daily solar advance with the mean motion to obtain the accumulated difference.

置第一段日平差，四百五十一分九十二秒，爲凡平積。

translations.literal: Set the first segment's daily mean difference at 451 parts 92 seconds as the general mean accumulation.
translations.idiomatic: Take the first segment's daily mean difference of 451 parts 92 seconds as the general mean accumulation.

sentences.zh: 以第一段二差一分三十三秒，去減第一段一差三十六分四十七秒，餘三十一分一十四秒，爲凡平積差。

translations.literal: Subtract the first segment's second difference of 1 part 33 seconds from the first segment's first difference of 36 parts 47 seconds; the remainder 31 parts 14 seconds is the general mean accumulated difference.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the first segment's second difference (1 part 33 seconds) from its first difference (36 parts 47 seconds); the remainder, 31 parts 14 seconds, is the general mean accumulated difference.

sentences.zh: 另置第一段二差一分三十三秒折半，得六十六秒五十微，爲凡立積差。

translations.literal: Separately set the first segment's second difference of 1 part 33 seconds and halve it, obtaining 66 seconds 50 micro-units as the general standing accumulated difference.
translations.idiomatic: Halve the first segment's second difference of 1 part 33 seconds to obtain 66 seconds 50 micro-units as the general standing accumulated difference.

sentences.zh: 以凡平積差三十五分一十四秒，加入凡平積四百五十一分九十二秒，共四百八十七分零六秒，爲定差。

translations.literal: Add the general mean accumulated difference of 35 parts 14 seconds to the general mean accumulation of 451 parts 92 seconds; together 487 parts 06 seconds is the fixed difference.
translations.idiomatic: Add the general mean accumulated difference of 35 parts 14 seconds to the general mean accumulation of 451 parts 92 seconds; the sum, 487 parts 06 seconds, is the fixed difference.

sentences.zh: 以凡『立積差六十六秒五十微，去減凡平差三十五分一十四秒，餘三十四分四十七秒五十微爲實，以段日一十五日六二爲法除之，得二分二十一秒，爲平差。

translations.literal: Subtract the general standing accumulated difference of 66 seconds 50 micro-units from the general mean difference of 35 parts 14 seconds; the remainder 34 parts 47 seconds 50 micro-units is the dividend; divide by the segment days of 15 days 62 ke, obtaining 2 parts 21 seconds as the mean difference.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the general standing accumulated difference (66 seconds 50 micro-units) from the general mean accumulated difference (35 parts 14 seconds); the remainder, 34 parts 47 seconds 50 micro-units, is the dividend. Dividing by the segment length of 15 days 62 ke yields 2 parts 21 seconds as the mean difference.

sentences.zh: 置凡立積差六十六秒五十微爲實，以段日爲法，除二次，得二十七微，爲立差。

translations.literal: Set the general standing accumulated difference of 66 seconds 50 micro-units as dividend; divide twice by the segment days as divisor, obtaining 27 micro-units as the standing difference.
translations.idiomatic: Take the general standing accumulated difference of 66 seconds 50 micro-units as dividend and divide twice by the segment days; the quotient, 27 micro-units, is the standing difference.

sentences.zh: 凡求盈縮，以入歷初末日乘立差，得數以加平差，再以初末日乘之，得數以減定差，餘數以初末日乘之，爲盈縮積。

translations.literal: In all, to seek expansion and contraction: multiply the standing difference by the first or last day of entry into the ephemeris; add the product to the mean difference; multiply again by the first or last day; subtract the product from the fixed difference; multiply the remainder by the first or last day to obtain the expansion–contraction accumulation.
translations.idiomatic: To find expansion and contraction: multiply the standing difference by the days from the start or end of ephemeris entry, add that to the mean difference, multiply again by those days, subtract from the fixed difference, and multiply the remainder by those days to obtain the expansion–contraction accumulation.

sentences.zh: 凡盈歷以八十日九零九二二五爲限，縮歷以九十三日七一二零二五爲限。

translations.literal: For expansion ephemerides the limit is 80 days 909225; for contraction ephemerides the limit is 93 days 712025.
translations.idiomatic: Expansion ephemerides use a limit of 80 days 909225; contraction ephemerides use a limit of 93 days 712025.

sentences.zh: 在其限已下爲初，以上轉減半歲周餘不末。

translations.literal: Below its limit counts as initial; above it, by rotating subtraction of the half-year circuit remainder, it becomes terminal.
translations.idiomatic: Within the limit counts as the initial phase; beyond it, by cyclic subtraction against the half-year circuit remainder, one reaches the terminal phase.

sentences.zh: 盈初是人冬至後順推，縮末是從冬至前逆溯，其距冬至同，故其盈積同。

translations.literal: Expansion-initial is forward reckoning after the winter solstice; contraction-final is reverse tracing before the winter solstice; their distances from the winter solstice are the same, so their expansion accumulations are the same.
translations.idiomatic: Expansion-initial is reckoned forward after the winter solstice; contraction-final is traced backward before the winter solstice. Because the distance from the winter solstice is the same, the expansion accumulation is the same.

sentences.zh: 縮初是從夏至後順推，盈末是從夏至前逆溯，其距夏至同，故其縮積同。

translations.literal: Contraction-initial is forward reckoning after the summer solstice; expansion-final is reverse tracing before the summer solstice; their distances from the summer solstice are the same, so their contraction accumulations are the same.
translations.idiomatic: Contraction-initial is reckoned forward after the summer solstice; expansion-final is traced backward before the summer solstice. Because the distance from the summer solstice is the same, the contraction accumulation is the same.

sentences.zh: 表格略
▲盈縮招差圖說

translations.literal: ▲ Diagram and explanation of expansion–contraction interpolation.

sentences.zh: 盈縮招生，本爲一象限之法。

translations.literal: Expansion–contraction interpolation arises from what is originally a one-quadrant method.
translations.idiomatic: Expansion–contraction interpolation derives from a method that treats a single quadrant.

sentences.zh: 如盈歷則以八十八日九十一刻爲象限，縮歷則以九十三日七十一刻爲象限。

translations.literal: For expansion ephemerides take 88 days 91 ke as the quadrant; for contraction ephemerides take 93 days 71 ke as the quadrant.
translations.idiomatic: For expansion ephemerides the quadrant is 88 days 91 ke; for contraction ephemerides it is 93 days 71 ke.

sentences.zh: 今止作九限者，舉此爲例也。

translations.literal: Now only nine limits are set forth—this is offered as an example.
translations.idiomatic: Here only nine steps are worked out, by way of illustration.

sentences.zh: 其空格九行定差本數，爲實也。

translations.literal: The nine blank rows' fixed-difference base numbers serve as the dividend.
translations.idiomatic: The fixed-difference base numbers in the nine blank rows are the dividend.

sentences.zh: 其斜綿以上平差立差之數，爲法也。

translations.literal: Above the oblique mesh, the mean-difference and standing-difference numbers serve as the divisor.
translations.idiomatic: Above the oblique mesh, the mean-difference and standing-difference values form the divisor.

sentences.zh: 斜綿以下空格之定差，乃餘實也。

translations.literal: The fixed differences in the blanks below the oblique mesh are the remainder-dividend.
translations.idiomatic: The fixed differences in the blanks below the oblique mesh are the remainder-dividend.

sentences.zh: 假如定差爲一萬，平差爲一百，立差爲單一。

translations.literal: Suppose the fixed difference is 10,000, the mean difference 100, and the standing difference a single unit.
translations.idiomatic: Suppose the fixed difference is 10,000, the mean difference 100, and the standing difference 1.

sentences.zh: 今求九限法，以九限乘定差得九萬爲實。

translations.literal: To seek the nine-limit method, multiply the fixed difference by nine limits, obtaining 90,000 as dividend.
translations.idiomatic: For the nine-step method, multiply the fixed difference by nine to obtain 90,000 as dividend.

sentences.zh: 另置平差，以九限乘二次，得八千一百。

translations.literal: Separately set the mean difference and multiply by nine limits twice, obtaining 8,100.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply the mean difference by nine twice to obtain 8,100.

sentences.zh: 置立差，以九限乘三次，得七百二十九。

translations.literal: Set the standing difference and multiply by nine limits thrice, obtaining 729.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply the standing difference by nine three times to obtain 729.

sentences.zh: 並兩數得八百二十九爲法。

translations.literal: Combine the two numbers to obtain 8,829 as divisor.
translations.idiomatic: Add the two products to obtain 8,829 as divisor.

sentences.zh: 以法減實，餘八萬一千一百七十一，爲九限積。

translations.literal: Subtract the divisor from the dividend; the remainder 81,171 is the nine-limit accumulation.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the divisor from the dividend; the remainder, 81,171, is the nine-step accumulation.

sentences.zh: 又法，以九限乘平差行九百，又以九限乘立差二次得八十一，並兩數得九進八十一爲法，定差一萬爲實，以法減實，餘矣千零一十九，即九限末位所書之定差也。

translations.literal: By the second method: multiply the mean difference by nine limits to obtain 900; multiply the standing difference by nine limits twice to obtain 81; combine the two to obtain 981 as divisor, with the fixed difference 10,000 as dividend; subtract the divisor from the dividend; the remainder 9,019 is the fixed difference written at the ninth-limit terminal.
translations.idiomatic: By the second method: nine times the mean difference gives 900; nine squared times the standing difference gives 81; together 981 is the divisor. With fixed difference 10,000 as dividend, subtract to obtain 9,019—the fixed difference entered at the ninth step.

sentences.zh: 於是瑞以九限乘餘實，得八萬一千一百七十一，爲九限積，與前所不所得不同。

translations.literal: Then multiply the remainder-dividend by nine limits, obtaining 81,171 as the nine-limit accumulation, which differs from what was obtained before.
translations.idiomatic: Then multiply the remainder-dividend by nine to obtain 81,171 as the nine-step accumulation—numerically different from the first procedure's intermediate steps.

sentences.zh: 蓋前法是先乘後減，又法是先減後乘，其理一也。

translations.literal: The former method multiplies first then subtracts; the latter subtracts first then multiplies—the principle is one.
translations.idiomatic: The first method multiplies then subtracts; the second subtracts then multiplies—the principle is the same.

sentences.zh: 按《授時曆》於七政盈縮，並以垛積招差立算，其污七巧合天行，與西人用小輪推步之法，殊途同歸。

translations.literal: Commentary: the Season Granting calendar, for the seven regulators' expansion and contraction, all established calculation by pile-summation interpolation; in the seven luminaries' coincidence with heaven's motion it matches the Westerners' epicycle step methods—different paths, same result.
translations.idiomatic: Commentary: In the Season Granting calendar, expansion and contraction for the seven regulators were all computed by pile-summation interpolation. Its fit to celestial motion parallels the Western epicycle methods—different routes, one outcome.

sentences.zh: 然世所傳《九章》諸書，不載其術，《歷草》載其術，而不言其故。

translations.literal: Yet the Nine Chapters and related books transmitted in the world do not record the technique; the Calendar Draft records the technique but does not explain its rationale.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the transmitted Nine Chapters and kindred works do not record the technique; the Calendar Draft gives the procedure but not the reasoning behind it.

sentences.zh: 宣城梅文鼎爲之圖解，於平差、立差之理，垛積之法，皆有以發明其所以然。

translations.literal: Mei Wencheng of Xuancheng made illustrated explanations, elucidating the rationale of mean difference and standing difference and the method of pile summation.
translations.idiomatic: Mei Wencheng of Xuancheng supplied illustrated explanations that set forth why mean and standing differences work and how pile summation operates.

sentences.zh: 有專書行於世，不能備錄，謹錄《招生圖說》，以明立法之大意云。

translations.literal: He has specialized books circulating in the world; they cannot all be recorded here—only the Diagram Explanation of Interpolation is excerpted to show the legislative intent.
translations.idiomatic: His monographs circulate widely and cannot all be quoted here; only the Diagram Explanation of Interpolation is recorded, to show the intent of the legislation.

sentences.zh: 盈初縮末 置立差三十一微，以六因之，得一秒八十六微，爲加分立差。

translations.literal: Expansion-initial, contraction-final: set the standing difference at 31 micro-units; multiply by six, obtaining 1 second 86 micro-units as the additive standing difference.
translations.idiomatic: Expansion-initial and contraction-final: take the standing difference of 31 micro-units, multiply by six, and obtain 1 second 86 micro-units as the incremental standing difference.

sentences.zh: 置平差二分四十六秒，倍之，得四分九十二秒，加入加分立差，得四分九十二秒八十六微，爲平立合差。

translations.literal: Set the mean difference at 2 parts 46 seconds and double it, obtaining 4 parts 92 seconds; add the additive standing difference to obtain 4 parts 92 seconds 86 micro-units as the combined mean–standing difference.
translations.idiomatic: Double the mean difference of 2 parts 46 seconds to get 4 parts 92 seconds; add the incremental standing difference for 4 parts 92 seconds 86 micro-units as the combined mean–standing difference.

sentences.zh: 置定差五百一十三分三十二秒，內減平差二分四十六秒，再減立差三十一微，餘五百一十零分八十五秒六十九微，爲加分。

translations.literal: Set the fixed difference at 513 parts 32 seconds; subtract within it the mean difference of 2 parts 46 seconds and again the standing difference of 31 micro-units; the remainder 510 parts 85 seconds 69 micro-units is the additive portion.
translations.idiomatic: From the fixed difference of 513 parts 32 seconds subtract the mean difference (2 parts 46 seconds) and the standing difference (31 micro-units); the remainder, 510 parts 85 seconds 69 micro-units, is the incremental correction.

sentences.zh: 縮初盈末 置立差二十七微，以六因之，得一秒六十二微，爲加分立差。

translations.literal: Contraction-initial, expansion-final: set the standing difference at 27 micro-units; multiply by six, obtaining 1 second 62 micro-units as the additive standing difference.
translations.idiomatic: Contraction-initial and expansion-final: take the standing difference of 27 micro-units, multiply by six, and obtain 1 second 62 micro-units as the incremental standing difference.

sentences.zh: 置平差二分二十一秒，倍之，得四分四十二秒，加入加分立差，得四分四十三秒六十二微，爲平立合差。

translations.literal: Set the mean difference at 2 parts 21 seconds and double it, obtaining 4 parts 42 seconds; add the additive standing difference to obtain 4 parts 43 seconds 62 micro-units as the combined mean–standing difference.
translations.idiomatic: Double the mean difference of 2 parts 21 seconds to get 4 parts 42 seconds; add the incremental standing difference for 4 parts 43 seconds 62 micro-units as the combined mean–standing difference.

sentences.zh: 置定差四百八十七分零六秒，內減平差二分二十一秒，再減立差二十七微，餘四百八十四分八十四秒七十三微，爲加分。

translations.literal: Set the fixed difference at 487 parts 06 seconds; subtract within it the mean difference of 2 parts 21 seconds and again the standing difference of 27 micro-units; the remainder 484 parts 84 seconds 73 micro-units is the additive portion.
translations.idiomatic: From the fixed difference of 487 parts 06 seconds subtract the mean difference (2 parts 21 seconds) and the standing difference (27 micro-units); the remainder, 484 parts 84 seconds 73 micro-units, is the incremental correction.

sentences.zh: 已上所推，皆初日之數。

translations.literal: What was derived above is all for the first day's numbers.
translations.idiomatic: The figures derived above are all for the first day.

sentences.zh: 其推次日，皆以加分立差，累加平立合差，爲次日平立合差。

translations.literal: To derive the next day, in each case add the additive standing difference cumulatively to the combined mean–standing difference to obtain the next day's combined mean–standing difference.
translations.idiomatic: For each following day, add the incremental standing difference cumulatively to the combined mean–standing difference to obtain that day's combined difference.

sentences.zh: 以平立合差減其日加分，爲次日加分，盈縮並同。

translations.literal: Subtract the combined mean–standing difference from that day's additive portion to obtain the next day's additive portion; expansion and contraction are alike.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the combined mean–standing difference from the day's incremental correction to obtain the next day's incremental correction; the rule is the same for expansion and contraction.

sentences.zh: 其加分累積之，即盈縮積，其數並見立成。

translations.literal: Cumulative addition of the additive portions is the expansion–contraction accumulation; the numbers all appear in the ready-made tables.
translations.idiomatic: Summing the incremental corrections yields the expansion–contraction accumulation; the values are given in the ready-made tables.

sentences.zh: ▲太陰遲疾平立三差之原

translations.literal: ▲ Origin of the lunar slow–fast mean, standing, and fixed three differences.
translations.idiomatic: ▲ Lunar slow–fast motion: origin of the three mean, standing, and fixed differences

sentences.zh: 太陰轉週二十七日五十五刻四六。

translations.literal: The Moon's rotation circuit is 27 days 55 ke 46.
translations.idiomatic: The Moon's rotation period is 27 days 55 ke 46.

sentences.zh: 測分四象，象各七段，四象二十八段，每段十二限，每象八十四限，凡三百三十六限，而四象一週。

translations.literal: Observations divide it into four images; each image has seven segments—four images, twenty-eight segments; each segment twelve limits; each image eighty-four limits; in all 336 limits, and the four images complete one circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Observation divides it into four quadrants of seven segments each—twenty-eight segments in all. Each segment has twelve limits, each quadrant eighty-four limits, 336 limits in total, completing one circuit in four quadrants.

sentences.zh: 以四象爲法，除轉週日，得每象六日八八八六五，分爲七段，每段下實測月行遲疾之數，與平行相較，以求積差。

translations.literal: Take the four images as divisor and divide the rotation-circuit days, obtaining per image 6 days 88865; divide into seven segments; for each segment set the observed lunar slow–fast numbers against mean motion to seek the accumulated difference.
translations.idiomatic: Dividing the rotation period by four quadrants gives 6 days 88865 per quadrant; divided into seven segments, each segment's observed slow–fast motion is compared with mean motion to obtain the accumulated difference.

translations.literal: Set the first segment's per-limit mean difference of 10 parts 726 as the general mean accumulation.
translations.idiomatic: Take the first segment's per-limit mean difference of 10 parts 726 as the general mean accumulation.

sentences.zh: 置第一段一差四十七秒七六，以第一段二差九秒三六減之，餘三十八秒四十微，爲凡平積差。

translations.literal: Set the first segment's first difference of 47 seconds 76; subtract the first segment's second difference of 9 seconds 36; the remainder 38 seconds 40 micro-units is the general mean accumulated difference.
translations.idiomatic: Take the first segment's first difference of 47 seconds 76 and subtract its second difference of 9 seconds 36; the remainder, 38 seconds 40 micro-units, is the general mean accumulated difference.

sentences.zh: 另置第一段二差九秒三十六微折半，得四秒六十八微，爲凡立積差。

translations.literal: Separately set the first segment's second difference of 9 seconds 36 micro-units and halve it, obtaining 4 seconds 68 micro-units as the general standing accumulated difference.
translations.idiomatic: Halve the first segment's second difference of 9 seconds 36 micro-units to obtain 4 seconds 68 micro-units as the general standing accumulated difference.

sentences.zh: 以凡平積差三十八秒四十微，加凡平積一十零分七二六，得一十一分一十一秒，爲定差。

translations.literal: Add the general mean accumulated difference of 38 seconds 40 wei to the general mean accumulation of 10 minutes 726, obtaining 11 minutes 11 seconds as the fixed difference.
translations.idiomatic: Adding the general mean accumulated difference of 38″40 wei to the general mean accumulation of 10′726 yields 11′11″ as the fixed difference.

sentences.zh: 置凡平積差三十八秒四十微，以凡立積差四秒六十八微減之，餘三十三秒七十二微爲實，以十二限爲法除之，得二秒八十一微，爲平差。

translations.literal: Set the general mean accumulated difference at 38 seconds 40 wei; subtract the general upright accumulated difference of 4 seconds 68 wei; the remainder 33 seconds 72 wei is the dividend; dividing by 12 limits as divisor gives 2 seconds 81 wei as the mean difference.
translations.idiomatic: Take the general mean accumulated difference of 38″40 wei and subtract the general upright accumulated difference of 4″68 wei; the remainder, 33″72 wei, is the dividend; dividing by 12 limits gives 2″81 wei as the mean difference.

sentences.zh: 置凡立積差四秒六十八微爲實，十二限爲法，除二次，得三微二十五纖，爲立差。

translations.literal: Set the general upright accumulated difference of 4 seconds 68 wei as dividend; with 12 limits as divisor, divide twice, obtaining 3 wei 25 xian as the upright difference.
translations.idiomatic: Set the general upright accumulated difference of 4″68 wei as dividend; dividing twice by 12 limits yields 3 wei 25 xian as the upright difference.

sentences.zh: 凡求遲疾，皆以入歷日乘十二限二十分，以在八十四限已下爲初，已上轉減一百六十八限餘爲末。

translations.literal: In all cases of seeking slow-fast, multiply the days entered into the cycle table by 12 limits 20 parts; if below 84 limits that is the beginning, if above convert by subtracting from 168 limits and the remainder is the end.
translations.idiomatic: To find slow-fast in every case, multiply the days entered into the ephemeris by 12 limits 20 parts; below 84 limits counts as the beginning, above that subtract from 168 limits and use the remainder as the end.

sentences.zh: 各以初末限乘立差，得數以加平差，再以初末限乘之，得數以減定差，餘以初末限乘之，爲遲疾積。

translations.literal: In each case multiply the beginning or end limit by the upright difference, add the number to the mean difference, multiply again by the beginning or end limit, subtract the number from the fixed difference, and multiply the remainder by the beginning or end limit to obtain the slow-fast accumulation.
translations.idiomatic: For each case, multiply the beginning or end limit by the upright difference and add to the mean difference; multiply again by that limit, subtract from the fixed difference, and multiply the remainder by the limit to obtain the slow-fast accumulation.

sentences.zh: 其初限是從最遲最疾處順推至後，末限是從最遲最疾處逆溯至前，其距其距最遲疾處同，故其積度同。

translations.literal: The beginning limit is forward from the point of greatest slowness and greatest speed; the end limit is backward from the point of greatest slowness and greatest speed; the distance from the point of greatest slowness and greatest speed is the same, so the accumulated degrees are the same.
translations.idiomatic: The beginning limit runs forward from the point of greatest slowness and greatest speed; the end limit runs backward from it; the distance from that point is the same in both cases, so the accumulated degrees are the same.

sentences.zh: 太陰與太陽立法同，但太陽以定氣立限，故盈縮異數。

translations.literal: The moon and the sun are legislated alike, but the sun establishes limits by fixed qi, so the surplus-deficit numbers differ.
translations.idiomatic: The moon and sun follow the same legislative pattern, but the sun sets its limits by fixed qi, so the surplus-deficit numbers differ.

sentences.zh: 太陰以平行立限，故遲疾同原。

translations.literal: The moon establishes limits by mean motion, so slow-fast matches the original.
translations.idiomatic: The moon sets its limits by mean motion, so the slow-fast values match the original constants.

sentences.zh: 布立成法 置立差三微二十五纖，以六因之，得一十九微五十纖，爲損益立差。

translations.literal: Deploy the ready-table method: set the upright difference at 3 wei 25 xian; multiply by 6, obtaining 19 wei 50 xian as the surplus-deficit upright difference.
translations.idiomatic: To deploy the ready-table method: set the upright difference at 3 wei 25 xian; multiplying by 6 gives 19 wei 50 xian as the surplus-deficit upright difference.

sentences.zh: 置平差二秒八十一微，倍之，得五秒六十二微，再加損益立差一十九微五十纖，共得五秒八十一微，爲初限平立合差。

translations.literal: Set the mean difference at 2 seconds 81 wei; double it, obtaining 5 seconds 62 wei; add the surplus-deficit upright difference of 19 wei 50 xian; the total is 5 seconds 81 wei as the beginning-limit mean-upright combined difference.
translations.idiomatic: Take the mean difference of 2″81 wei and double it to 5″62 wei; adding the surplus-deficit upright difference of 19 wei 50 xian gives 5″81 wei as the beginning-limit mean-upright combined difference.

sentences.zh: 自此以損益立差，累加之，即每限平立合差。

translations.literal: From here onward, accumulate by adding the surplus-deficit upright difference; that is each limit's mean-upright combined difference.
translations.idiomatic: From here, each limit's mean-upright combined difference is obtained by cumulatively adding the surplus-deficit upright difference.

sentences.zh: 至八十限下，積至二十一秒四一五，爲平立合差之極。

translations.literal: By the eightieth limit, the accumulation reaches 21 seconds 415 as the extreme of the mean-upright combined difference.
translations.idiomatic: By the eightieth limit the accumulation reaches 21″415, the maximum of the mean-upright combined difference.

sentences.zh: 八十一限下差一秒七八零九，八十二限下一秒七八零八，至八十三限下，平立合差，與益分中分，爲益分之終。

translations.literal: At the eighty-first limit the difference is 1 second 7809; at the eighty-second limit, 1 second 7808; by the eighty-third limit the mean-upright combined difference equals the middle of the surplus part—the end of the surplus part.
translations.idiomatic: At the eighty-first limit the difference is 1″7809; at the eighty-second, 1″7808; by the eighty-third limit the mean-upright combined difference reaches the midpoint of the surplus portion—the end of the surplus part.

sentences.zh: 八十四限下差，亦與損分中分，爲損分之始。

translations.literal: At the eighty-fourth limit the difference likewise equals the middle of the deficit part—the beginning of the deficit part.
translations.idiomatic: At the eighty-fourth limit the difference likewise reaches the midpoint of the deficit portion—the beginning of the deficit part.

sentences.zh: 至八十六限下差，亦二十一秒四一五，自此以損益立差累減之，即每限平立合差，至末限與初限同。

translations.literal: By the eighty-sixth limit the difference is again 21 seconds 415; from here accumulate by subtracting the surplus-deficit upright difference; that is each limit's mean-upright combined difference, until the end limit matches the beginning limit.
translations.idiomatic: By the eighty-sixth limit the difference is again 21″415; from here each limit's mean-upright combined difference is obtained by cumulatively subtracting the surplus-deficit upright difference, until the end limit matches the beginning.

sentences.zh: 置定差一十一分一十一秒，內減平差二秒八十一微，再減立差三微二十五纖，餘一十一分零八秒一十五微七十五纖爲加分定差，即初限損益分。

translations.literal: Set the fixed difference at 11 minutes 11 seconds; subtract within it the mean difference of 2 seconds 81 wei and again the upright difference of 3 wei 25 xian; the remainder 11 minutes 08 seconds 15 wei 75 xian is the additive fixed difference—that is, the beginning-limit surplus-deficit parts.
translations.idiomatic: Set the fixed difference at 11′11″; subtract the mean difference of 2″81 wei and the upright difference of 3 wei 25 xian; the remainder, 11′08″15 wei 75 xian, is the additive fixed difference—the beginning-limit surplus-deficit parts.

sentences.zh: 置損益分，以其限平立合差益減損加之。

translations.literal: Set the surplus-deficit part; by that limit's mean-upright combined difference add for surplus and subtract for deficit.
translations.idiomatic: Take the surplus-deficit part and add or subtract according to that limit's mean-upright combined difference—adding for surplus portions and subtracting for deficit portions.

sentences.zh: 即爲次限損益分。

translations.literal: That is the next limit's surplus-deficit part.
translations.idiomatic: The result is the next limit's surplus-deficit part.

sentences.zh: 以益分積之，損分減之，便爲其下遲疾度。

translations.literal: Accumulate the surplus parts and subtract the deficit parts; that is the slow-fast degree below.
translations.idiomatic: Accumulate the surplus portions and subtract the deficit portions to obtain the slow-fast degree for the limit below.

sentences.zh: 以八百二十分爲一限日率，累加八百二十分爲每限日率。

translations.literal: Take 820 parts as one limit's day-rate; accumulating by adding 820 parts gives each limit's day-rate.
translations.idiomatic: Take 820 parts as one limit's day-rate; cumulatively adding 820 parts yields each limit's day-rate.

sentences.zh: 以上俱詳立成。

translations.literal: All the above are detailed in the ready-made table.
translations.idiomatic: All of the above is set out in detail in the ready-made table.

sentences.zh: 五星平立定三差之原 凡五星各以實測，分其行度爲八段，以求積差，略如日月法。

translations.literal: Origin of the five stars' mean, upright, and fixed three differences: for each of the five stars, by actual measurement divide its motion into eight segments to seek the accumulated difference, broadly like the sun-and-moon method.
translations.idiomatic: Origin of the five planets' mean, upright, and fixed three differences: for each planet, actual measurement divides its motion into eight segments to derive the accumulated difference, broadly parallel to the sun-and-moon procedure.

sentences.zh: 木星立差加，平差減。

translations.literal: Jupiter: the upright difference is added; the mean difference is subtracted.
translations.idiomatic: Jupiter: the upright difference is added and the mean difference subtracted.

translations.literal: Set half the general upright comparison, 3 seconds 1211; with segment days as divisor, divide twice, obtaining 2 wei 36 xian as the upright difference.
translations.idiomatic: Take half the general upright comparison, 3″1211; dividing twice by the segment days yields 2 wei 36 xian as the upright difference.

translations.idiomatic: The above constitutes the origin of Jupiter's mean, upright, and fixed three differences.

術同金星，求得定差三分八十七秒九十微，平差二十一微六十五纖，立差一微四十一纖。

translations.literal: The method is the same as for Venus; the fixed difference is obtained as 3 parts 87 seconds 90 micro-units, the mean difference as 21 micro-units 65 xian, and the upright difference as 1 micro-unit 41 xian.
translations.idiomatic: The procedure matches Venus, yielding a fixed difference of 3′87″90 wei, a mean difference of 21 wei 65 xian, and an upright difference of 1 wei 41 xian.

sentences.zh: 已上爲水星平立定三差之原。

translations.literal: The above is the origin of Mercury's mean, upright, and fixed three differences.
translations.idiomatic: The above constitutes the origin of Mercury's mean, upright, and fixed three differences.

sentences.zh: 在五星，皆以立差爲秒，平差爲本，定差爲總。

translations.literal: Among the five planets, in every case the upright difference serves as seconds, the mean difference as base, and the fixed difference as total.
translations.idiomatic: For all five planets, the upright difference counts as seconds, the mean difference as the base, and the fixed difference as the total.

sentences.zh: 五星各以段次因秒，木土金水四星並本，惟火星較本，各以積日而積，五星皆較總，又各以積日乘之，得各實測之度分。

translations.literal: Each of the five planets, by segment order, applies the seconds; Wood, Earth, Metal, and Water all join to the base, only Mars compares to the base; each accumulates by accumulated days; all five planets compare to the total, and again each multiplies by accumulated days, obtaining each planet's actually measured degrees and parts.
translations.idiomatic: Each planet applies the seconds by segment order; Jupiter, Saturn, Venus, and Mercury all add to the base, while only Mars compares against the base; each accumulates by accumulated days; all five then compare to the total and multiply again by accumulated days to obtain each planet's observed degrees and parts.

sentences.zh: 五星積日，皆本度率，除週日得三百六十五度二十五分太。

translations.literal: Each planet's accumulated days is based on the degree rate; dividing by the circuit days yields 365 degrees 25 parts surplus.
translations.idiomatic: Each planet's accumulated days derives from the degree rate; dividing by the circuit days yields 365°25′ surplus.

sentences.zh: 各以四分之一爲象限，惟火星用象限三之一，減象限爲盈初縮末限，加象限爲縮初盈末限。

translations.literal: Each takes one-quarter as the quadrant; only Mars uses one-third of the quadrant; subtracting the quadrant gives the surplus-initial and deficit-final limit; adding the quadrant gives the deficit-initial and surplus-final limit.
translations.idiomatic: Each planet takes one-quarter of its cycle as the quadrant; Mars alone uses one-third; subtracting the quadrant gives the surplus-at-beginning and deficit-at-end limit, and adding it gives the deficit-at-beginning and surplus-at-end limit.

sentences.zh: 其命度爲日者，爲各取盈縮歷乘除之便，其實積日之數，即積度也。

translations.literal: Where degrees are named as days, this is for convenience in multiplying and dividing by each planet's surplus-deficit ephemeris; in fact the number of accumulated days is the accumulated degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Naming degrees as days is only a convenience for multiplying and dividing in each planet's surplus-deficit table; in reality accumulated days and accumulated degrees are the same number.

sentences.zh: ▲裏差刻漏
求二至差股及出入差。

translations.literal: To find the solstitial difference legs and the ingress-egress difference.
translations.idiomatic: To find the solstitial-difference legs and the ingress-egress difference.

sentences.zh: 術曰：置所測北極出地四十度九十五分爲半弧背，以前割圓弧矢法，推得出地半弧弦三十九度二十六分，爲大三斜中股。

translations.literal: Method: Set the observed north-pole altitude above the horizon at 40 degrees 95 parts as the half-arc back; by the prior circle-cutting arc-sagitta method, derive the half-arc chord of altitude above earth at 39 degrees 26 parts as the large third triangle's middle leg.
translations.idiomatic: Method: Take the observed north-pole altitude of 40°95′ as the half-arc back; by the prior circle-cutting arc-sagitta method, derive the altitude half-arc chord of 39°26′ as the large third triangle's middle leg.

sentences.zh: 置測到二至黃赤道內外度二十三度九十分爲半弧背，以前法推得內外半弧弦二十三度七十一分。

translations.literal: Set the measured solstitial yellow-red path inner and outer degree at 23 degrees 90 parts as the half-arc back; by the prior method derive the inner and outer half-arc chord at 23 degrees 71 parts.
translations.idiomatic: Take the measured solstitial ecliptic-equator inner-outer arc of 23°90′ as the half-arc back; by the same method derive the inner-outer half-arc chord of 23°71′.

sentences.zh: 又爲黃赤道大句，又爲小三斜弦。

translations.literal: This also serves as the yellow-red path's large leg, and also as the small third triangle's hypotenuse.
translations.idiomatic: This is also the ecliptic-equator's large leg and the small third triangle's hypotenuse.

sentences.zh: 置內外半弧弦自之爲句冪，半徑自之爲弦冪，二冪相減，開方得股，以股轉減半徑，餘四度八十一分爲二至出入矢，即黃赤道內外矢。

translations.literal: Set the inner-outer half-arc chord squared as the leg power; set the half-diameter squared as the chord power; subtract the two powers and take the square root to obtain the leg; subtract the leg in turn from the half-diameter; the remainder 4 degrees 81 parts is the solstitial ingress-egress sagitta—that is, the yellow-red path inner-outer sagitta.
translations.idiomatic: Square the inner-outer half-arc chord for the leg power and the half-diameter for the chord power; subtract, take the square root for the leg, and subtract that leg from the half-diameter; the remainder, 4°81′, is the solstitial ingress-egress sagitta—the ecliptic-equator inner-outer sagitta.

sentences.zh: 夏至日，南至地平七十四度二十六分半爲半弧背，求得日下至地半弧弦五十八度四十五分。

translations.literal: On the summer-solstice day, the sun's south reach to the horizon at 74 degrees 26 parts and a half is the half-arc back; the half-arc chord from the sun's lower culmination to earth is obtained as 58 degrees 45 parts.
translations.idiomatic: At the summer solstice, take the sun's southern altitude of 74°26½ as the half-arc back; the half-arc chord from the sun down to the earth is 58°45′.

sentences.zh: 半徑六十零度八十七分半，爲大三斜中弦。

translations.literal: The half-diameter 60 degrees 87 parts and a half is the large third triangle's middle hypotenuse.
translations.idiomatic: The half-diameter of 60°87½ serves as the large third triangle's middle hypotenuse.

sentences.zh: 置大三斜中股三十九度二十六分，以二至內外半弧弦二十三度七十一分乘之爲實，以半徑六十零度八十七分半爲法除之，得一十五度二十九分，爲小三斜中股又爲小股。

translations.literal: Set the large third triangle's middle leg at 39 degrees 26 parts; multiply it by the solstitial inner-outer half-arc chord of 23 degrees 71 parts as dividend; divide by the half-diameter of 60 degrees 87 parts and a half as divisor, obtaining 15 degrees 29 parts as the small third triangle's middle leg, which is also the small leg.
translations.idiomatic: Take the large third triangle's middle leg of 39°26′, multiply by the solstitial inner-outer half-arc chord of 23°71′ as dividend, and divide by the half-diameter of 60°87½ to obtain 15°29′ as the small third triangle's middle leg—the small leg.

sentences.zh: 置小三斜中股一十五度二十九分，去減日下至地半弧弦五十八度中十一分，餘四十三度一十六分，爲大股。

translations.literal: Set the small third triangle's middle leg at 15 degrees 29 parts; subtract it from the half-arc chord from the sun's lower culmination to earth at 58 degrees 45 parts; the remainder 43 degrees 16 parts is the large leg.
translations.idiomatic: Take the small third triangle's middle leg of 15°29′ and subtract it from the sun-to-earth half-arc chord of 58°45′; the remainder, 43°16′, is the large leg.

sentences.zh: 以出入矢四度八十一分，去減半徑六十零度八十七分半，餘五十六度零六分半，爲大股弦。

translations.literal: Subtract the ingress-egress sagitta of 4 degrees 81 parts from the half-diameter of 60 degrees 87 parts and a half; the remainder 56 degrees 06 parts and a half is the large leg's hypotenuse.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the ingress-egress sagitta of 4°81′ from the half-diameter of 60°87½; the remainder, 56°06½, is the large leg's hypotenuse.

sentences.zh: 置大股弦，以小股一十五度二九乘之爲實，大股四十三度一六爲法除之，得一十九度八十七分爲小弦，即爲二至出入差半弧弦。

translations.literal: Set the great-leg chord; multiply by the small leg of 15 degrees 29 for dividend; divide by the great leg of 43 degrees 16 as divisor; obtain 19 degrees 87 fen as small chord, which is the solstitial entry-and-exit difference half-arc chord.
translations.idiomatic: Set the great-leg chord; multiply by the small leg of 15°29′ for the dividend and divide by the great leg of 43°16′ as divisor; the quotient, 19°87′, is the small chord—that is, the solstitial entry-and-exit difference half-arc chord.

sentences.zh: 置二至出入差半弧弦，依法求到二至出入差半弧背一十九度九十六分一十四秒。

translations.literal: Set the solstitial entry-and-exit difference half-arc chord; by the prescribed method seek the solstitial entry-and-exit difference half-arc back of 19 degrees 96 fen 14 miao.
translations.idiomatic: Set the solstitial entry-and-exit difference half-arc chord; by the prescribed method obtain the solstitial entry-and-exit difference half-arc back of 19°96′14″.

sentences.zh: 置二至出入差半弧背一十九度九十六一四秒，置二至出入半弧背一十九度九六一四，以二至黃赤道內外半弧弦二十三度七十一分除之，得八十四分一十九秒，爲度差分。

translations.literal: Set the solstitial entry-and-exit difference half-arc back of 19 degrees 9614 miao; set the solstitial entry-and-exit half-arc back of 19 degrees 9614; divide by the solstitial ecliptic-equator inner-and-outer half-arc chord of 23 degrees 71 fen; obtain 84 fen 19 miao as the degree-difference parts.
translations.idiomatic: Set the solstitial entry-and-exit difference half-arc back at 19°9614″ and the solstitial entry-and-exit half-arc back at 19°9614; dividing by the solstitial ecliptic-equator inner-and-outer half-arc chord of 23°71′ yields 84′19″ as the degree-difference parts.

sentences.zh: 求黃道每度書夜刻。

translations.literal: To find the day-and-night quarter-hour graduations for each degree of the ecliptic.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to find the day-and-night quarter-hour graduations for each degree of the ecliptic.

sentences.zh: 術曰：置所求每度黃赤道內外半弧弦，以二至出入差半弧背乘之爲實，二至黃赤道內外半弧弦爲法除之，爲每度出入差半弧背。

translations.literal: The procedure says: Set the inner-and-outer half-arc chord of the ecliptic-equator for the sought degree; multiply by the solstitial entry-and-exit difference half-arc back as dividend; divide by the solstitial ecliptic-equator inner-and-outer half-arc chord as divisor; this is the per-degree entry-and-exit difference half-arc back.
translations.idiomatic: The procedure says: Take the inner-and-outer half-arc chord of the ecliptic-equator for the sought degree, multiply by the solstitial entry-and-exit difference half-arc back as dividend, and divide by the solstitial ecliptic-equator inner-and-outer half-arc chord as divisor to obtain the per-degree entry-and-exit difference half-arc back.

sentences.zh: 又術：置黃赤道內外半弧弦，以度差八十四分一十九秒乘之，亦得出入差半弧背。

translations.literal: Alternate procedure: Set the ecliptic-equator inner-and-outer half-arc chord; multiply by the degree difference of 84 fen 19 miao; likewise obtain the entry-and-exit difference half-arc back.
translations.idiomatic: Alternate procedure: Take the ecliptic-equator inner-and-outer half-arc chord and multiply by the degree difference of 84′19″; the entry-and-exit difference half-arc back is obtained likewise.

sentences.zh: 置半徑內減黃赤道內外矢，即赤道二絃差，見前條立成。

translations.literal: Set the semidiameter and subtract within it the ecliptic-equator inner-and-outer versine; this is the equatorial two-chord difference—see the ready reckoners in the preceding section.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the ecliptic-equator inner-and-outer versine from the semidiameter; the remainder is the equatorial two-chord difference—see the ready reckoners in the preceding section.

sentences.zh: 餘數倍之，又三因之，得數加一度，爲日行百刻度。

translations.literal: Double the remainder, then multiply by three; add one degree to the number obtained—this is the daily motion in hundred-ke graduations.
translations.idiomatic: Double the remainder, multiply by three, and add one degree; the result is the daily motion in hundred-ke graduations.

sentences.zh: 又術：以黃赤道內外矢倍之，以減全徑餘數，三因加一度，爲日行百刻度，亦同。

translations.literal: Alternate procedure: Double the ecliptic-equator inner-and-outer versine; subtract the remainder from the full diameter; multiply by three and add one degree—for daily motion in hundred-ke graduations; same result.
translations.idiomatic: Alternate procedure: Double the ecliptic-equator inner-and-outer versine and subtract from the full diameter; triple the remainder and add one degree to obtain the daily motion in hundred-ke graduations—the result is the same.

sentences.zh: 置每度出入半弧背，以百刻乘之爲實，日行百刻爲法除之，得數爲出入差刻。

translations.literal: Set the per-degree entry-and-exit half-arc back; multiply by 100 ke as dividend; divide by daily motion in hundred ke as divisor; the quotient is the entry-and-exit difference in ke.
translations.idiomatic: Take the per-degree entry-and-exit half-arc back, multiply by 100 ke as dividend, and divide by the daily motion in hundred-ke graduations as divisor; the quotient is the entry-and-exit difference in ke.

sentences.zh: 置二十五刻，以出入差刻視黃道，在赤道內加之，在赤道外減之，得數爲半晝刻，倍之爲晝刻，以減百刻，爲夜刻。

translations.literal: Set 25 ke; according to whether the ecliptic lies within or without the equator, add or subtract the entry-and-exit difference ke to obtain half-daytime ke; double for daytime ke; subtract from 100 ke for nighttime ke.
translations.idiomatic: Set 25 ke; according to whether the ecliptic lies within or outside the equator, add or subtract the entry-and-exit difference ke to obtain half-daytime ke; double it for daytime ke and subtract from 100 ke for nighttime ke.

sentences.zh: 如求冬至後四度晝刻。

translations.literal: Example: to find daytime ke four degrees after the winter solstice.
translations.idiomatic: Example: finding the daytime ke four degrees after the winter solstice.

sentences.zh: 術曰：置冬至後四十四度黃赤道內外半弧一十七度二十五分六十九秒，又爲黃赤道小弧弦，前立成中取之。

translations.literal: The procedure says: Set the ecliptic-equator inner-and-outer half-arc at 44 degrees after the winter solstice, 17 degrees 25 fen 69 miao; this also serves as the ecliptic-equator small arc-chord—take it from the ready reckoners above.
translations.idiomatic: The procedure says: Take the ecliptic-equator inner-and-outer half-arc at 44° after the winter solstice, 17°25′69″—which also serves as the ecliptic-equator small arc-chord—from the ready reckoners above.

sentences.zh: 以二至出入差半弧背一十九度九十六分一十四秒乘之爲實，以二至黃赤道內外半弧弦二十三度七十一分爲法除之，得一十四度五十二分八十五秒，爲出入半弧背。

translations.literal: Multiply by the solstitial entry-and-exit difference half-arc back of 19 degrees 96 fen 14 miao as dividend; divide by the solstitial ecliptic-equator inner-and-outer half-arc chord of 23 degrees 71 fen as divisor; obtain 14 degrees 52 fen 85 miao as entry-and-exit half-arc back.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply by the solstitial entry-and-exit difference half-arc back of 19°96′14″ as dividend and divide by the solstitial ecliptic-equator inner-and-outer half-arc chord of 23°71′ as divisor; the quotient, 14°52′85″, is the entry-and-exit half-arc back.

sentences.zh: 又法：置黃赤道內外半弧弦一十七度二五六九，以度差零度八四一九乘之，亦得一十四度五二八五，爲出入半弧背。

translations.literal: Alternate method: Set the inner-and-outer half-arc chord of 17 degrees 2569; multiply by the degree difference of 0 degrees 8419; likewise obtain 14 degrees 5285 as entry-and-exit half-arc back.
translations.idiomatic: Alternate method: Take the inner-and-outer half-arc chord of 17°2569 and multiply by the degree difference of 0°8419; the entry-and-exit half-arc back of 14°5285 is obtained likewise.

sentences.zh: 置半徑六十零度八七五，以四十四度黃赤道內外矢二度五十一分八十一秒又爲赤道二絃差，前立成中取之。

translations.literal: Set the semidiameter at 60 degrees 875; subtract the ecliptic-equator inner-and-outer versine at 44 degrees after the winter solstice, 2 degrees 51 fen 81 miao, also the equatorial two-chord difference from the ready reckoners above.
translations.idiomatic: Set the semidiameter at 60°875 and subtract the ecliptic-equator inner-and-outer versine at 44° after the winter solstice, 2°51′81″—also taken as the equatorial two-chord difference from the ready reckoners above.

sentences.zh: 減之，餘五十八度三十五分六十九秒，即赤道小弦。

translations.literal: The remainder 58 degrees 35 fen 69 miao is the equatorial small chord.
translations.idiomatic: The remainder, 58°35′69″, is the equatorial small chord.

sentences.zh: 倍之，得一百一十六度七十一分三十八秒，三因之，加一度，得三百五十一度一十四分一十四秒，爲日行百刻度。

translations.literal: Double to obtain 116 degrees 71 fen 38 miao; multiply by three and add one degree to obtain 351 degrees 14 fen 14 miao as daily motion in hundred-ke graduations.
translations.idiomatic: Double it to obtain 116°71′38″; triple the result and add one degree to obtain 351°14′14″ as the daily motion in hundred-ke graduations.

sentences.zh: 又術：倍黃赤道內外矢得五度零三分六十二秒，以減全徑一百二十一度七十五分，亦得一百一十六度七十一分三十八秒，三因加一度，爲日行百刻度，亦同。

translations.literal: Alternate procedure: Double the versine to obtain 5 degrees 03 fen 62 miao; subtract from the full diameter of 121 degrees 75 fen; likewise obtain 116 degrees 71 fen 38 miao; triple and add one degree—for daily motion in hundred-ke; same.
translations.idiomatic: Alternate procedure: Double the versine to obtain 5°03′62″ and subtract from the full diameter of 121°75′; the remainder is again 116°71′38″; triple it and add one degree for the daily motion in hundred-ke graduations—the result is the same.

sentences.zh: 置出入半弧背一十四度五十二分八十五秒，以百刻乘之爲實，以日行百刻度三百五十一度一十四分一十四秒爲法除之，得四刻一十三分七十五秒，爲出入差刻。

translations.literal: Set the entry-and-exit half-arc back of 14 degrees 52 fen 85 miao; multiply by 100 ke as dividend; divide by daily motion of 351 degrees 14 fen 14 miao as divisor; obtain 4 ke 13 fen 75 miao as entry-and-exit difference ke.
translations.idiomatic: Take the entry-and-exit half-arc back of 14°52′85″, multiply by 100 ke as dividend, and divide by the daily motion of 351°14′14″ as divisor; the quotient is 4 ke 13 parts 75 seconds as the entry-and-exit difference ke.

sentences.zh: 置二十五刻，以出入差刻四刻一十三分七十五秒減之，因冬至後四十四度，黃道在赤道外，故減。

translations.literal: Set 25 ke; subtract the entry-and-exit difference ke of 4 ke 13 fen 75 miao; because at 44 degrees after the winter solstice the ecliptic lies outside the equator, therefore subtract.
translations.idiomatic: Set 25 ke and subtract the entry-and-exit difference ke of 4 ke 13 parts 75 seconds; at 44° after the winter solstice the ecliptic lies outside the equator, so one subtracts.

sentences.zh: 餘二十零刻八十六分二十五秒，爲半晝刻。

translations.literal: The remainder 20 ke 86 fen 25 miao is half-daytime ke.
translations.idiomatic: The remainder, 20 ke 86 parts 25 seconds, is half-daytime ke.

sentences.zh: 倍之得四十一刻七十二分半，爲晝刻。

translations.literal: Double to obtain 41 ke 72 parts and a half as daytime ke.
translations.idiomatic: Double it to obtain 41 ke 72 parts and a half as daytime ke.

sentences.zh: 以晝刻減百刻，餘五十八刻二十七分半，爲夜刻。

translations.literal: Subtract daytime ke from 100 ke; the remainder 58 ke 27 parts and a half is nighttime ke.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the daytime ke from 100 ke; the remainder, 58 ke 27 parts and a half, is nighttime ke.

sentences.zh: 又術：置出入差刻四刻一十三分七十五秒，倍之，得八刻二十七分半，以減春秋分晝夜五十刻，得四十一刻七十二分半，爲晝刻。

translations.literal: Alternate procedure: Set the entry-and-exit difference ke of 4 ke 13 fen 75 miao; double to obtain 8 ke 27 parts and a half; subtract from the spring-and-autumn equinox day-and-night of 50 ke each; obtain 41 ke 72 parts and a half as daytime ke.
translations.idiomatic: Alternate procedure: Take the entry-and-exit difference ke of 4 ke 13 parts 75 seconds and double it to obtain 8 ke 27 parts and a half; subtract from the spring-and-autumn equinox day-and-night of 50 ke each to obtain 41 ke 72 parts and a half as daytime ke.

sentences.zh: 以倍刻加五十刻，得五十八刻二十七分半，爲夜刻。

translations.literal: Add the doubled ke to 50 ke; obtain 58 ke 27 parts and a half as nighttime ke.
translations.idiomatic: Add the doubled ke to 50 ke to obtain 58 ke 27 parts and a half as nighttime ke.

sentences.zh: 晝減故廢加，餘仿此。

translations.literal: When daytime uses subtraction, the addition [method] is set aside; follow this rule elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: Where daytime is found by subtraction, the addition method is set aside; apply the rest by analogy.

sentences.zh: 表格略
右《歷草》所載晝夜刻分，乃大都即燕京晷漏也。

translations.literal: The day-and-night quarter-hour graduations recorded in the Calendar Draft to the right are those of Dadu—that is, the clepsydra graduations of Yanjing.
translations.idiomatic: The day-and-night quarter-hour graduations recorded in the Calendar Draft above are those of Dadu—that is, the clepsydra graduations of Yanjing (Beijing).

sentences.zh: 夏晝、冬夜極長，六十一刻八十四分，冬晝、夏夜極短，三十八刻一十六分。

translations.literal: Summer daytime and winter night are longest at 61 ke 84 parts; winter daytime and summer night shortest at 38 ke 16 parts.
translations.idiomatic: Summer daytime and winter night reach their maximum at 61 ke 84 parts; winter daytime and summer night their minimum at 38 ke 16 parts.

sentences.zh: 明既遷都於燕，不知遵用。

translations.literal: Once the Ming moved the capital to Yan, they did not know to follow and use [these graduations].
translations.idiomatic: After the Ming moved the capital to Yan, they did not adhere to these graduations.

sentences.zh: 惟正統己巳奏準頒歷用六十一刻，而羣然非之。

translations.literal: Only in Zhengtong's jisi year was approval granted to issue the calendar using 61 ke—and the crowd denounced it together.
translations.idiomatic: Only in the Zhengtong jisi year (1449) was approval granted to issue the calendar using 61 ke—and there was widespread objection.

sentences.zh: 景泰初仍復用南京晷刻，終明之世未能改正也。

translations.literal: At the start of Jingtai they again reverted to Nanjing clepsydra graduations; through the whole Ming they could not correct it.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Jingtai reign they reverted to Nanjing clepsydra graduations, and through the entire Ming the error was never corrected.
